Rashid bin Muhammad states:
I am a native of Sawakir. I knew Khaimullah and his sister Sa'idah in Sawakir 27 years ago.
Soon after I came here I recognised Sa'idah at Tamburah where she used to come often.
I heard 3 days ago that she was about to be sold by Abu Jarwah in whose house she was working.
She was offered in sale to a person whose name I have not heard who refused to buy her as slave.
